thread:
Nora Chen: FYI - Solitude Labs flagged by billing-bot for low renewal signal. Usage cratered after champion left and procurement has initiated a parallel eval with CascadeAI. We need a concise playbook and customer-facing option set. Can folks spare 20m?
onboard-bot: Account summary for solitude-labs:
  - 24h tokens: 2.1k
  - 7d tokens: 14.7k (\u221275% WoW)
  - Active seats: 8 -> 3 (contracted 15)
  - Last API call: 2026-03-11 09:12 UTC
  - Tags: competitor-cascade-trial, procurement-new-owner
  - Dashboard: https://redwood.app/accounts/solitude-labs
billing-bot: Alert: renewal_likelihood=low because MRR trend < -60% and no open QBR scheduled. Suggested actions: outreach, health check, targeted demo.
Samir Gupta: Noted. I dug into request logs: embed-search errors in their client show intermittent 502/timeout retries. They may have switched traffic to Cascade during failures. I'll capture the exact error windows and correlate to their SDK version.
Ava Martinez: I can run a lightweight recovery play: 1) quick error mitigation doc for their devs (1 pager), 2) tailored performance checklist, 3) offer of a \"peak day\" Dedicated trial. Prefer we push the dev doc first to remove friction.
Leo Torres: For procurement, recommend two tracks: (1) \"Recovery + Optimize\" — free 1-hour SRE session + 10% credit for 30 days, focused on retry/backoff and prefix caching (no infra commitment). (2) \"Confidence Test\" — 7-day Dedicated trial with SLA runway and a benchmark report.
Nora Chen: Good split. The procurement contact asks to see cost delta vs Cascade; can we produce a simple delta table showing expected tokens, p95 latency, and estimated monthly cost at 50k tokens/day?
Samir Gupta: I'll run a sim of their top two routes with and without prefix cache + batching. Expect ~25-35% token reduction on median, but p99 will be stubborn due to long prompts. Will post by EOD.
Ava Martinez: I'll draft the dev-facing doc and a short troubleshooting checklist. Also recommend a short enablement workshop for their new engineer owners.
Leo Torres: I'm drafting two email templates: (A) technical recovery note for engineers, (B) procurement offer with numbers + test plan. Nora — want to approve tone?
Nora Chen: Keep it proactive, not defensive. Frame as \"we want to make the evaluation fair and fast\". No discounts up front unless they commit to the trial. Use credits for recovery instead.
Samir Gupta: Uploading initial sim: https://redwood.app/sims/solitude-cascade-comparison. Key note: their p95 is dominated by seq-length and external API calls in prompt. We should recommend prompt denormalization and a cached intermediary for metadata.
Ava Martinez: Workshop agenda draft: 30m dev triage (errors + SDK), 30m perf tuning (batching + cache), 15m roadmap/next steps. Can run this week.
Nora Chen: Okay — immediate actions: 1) Samir post sim and error windows, 2) Ava publish 1-pager + workshop invite, 3) Leo finalize both email templates, 4) I'll request a QBR with their execs and keep this out of sales for now. I'll post a succinct update after the workshop. :white_check_mark:
